title: Graceful Behavior Phaseout Orchestrator — migration sherpa for streaming, tool-calls, and structured outputs
creator: Asha Nambiar
description: Goal: Build an orchestrator and supporting artifacts that let us phase out legacy API behaviors (streaming formats, tool/function calling signatures, and structured-output schemas) with minimal customer disruption. Deliver a 'Migration Sherpa' that guides customers through detection, remediation, and staged rollout, plus an automated compat test harness that exercises streaming, tool-calls, and structured outputs under both old and new behavior flags. Scope: 1) behavior-gate orchestrator service (policy-driven waves + auto-rollbacks), 2) Migration Sherpa CLI + generated client snippets, 3) Replayable regression corpus + replayer harness for streaming/tool-calls/structured-outputs, 4) telemetry and signal definitions for regressions (quality, latency, error rates), 5) SDK helpers for graceful fallback and opt-in flags, 6) rollout runbooks and customer-facing migration guide. Out of scope: major client library rewrites — Sherpa produces patches/snippets and recommended steps only.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can schedule and execute multi-wave rollouts with per-wave percentage targets and automatic rollback on defined thresholds
Migration Sherpa CLI can generate a per-customer migration checklist and a patch snippet for Node/Python SDKs from a provided API usage sample
Compat test harness can replay 10k representative streaming sessions and 5k tool-call invocations from corpus and report semantic diffs against golden outputs
Telemetry alerts trigger when output-schema validation failures or function-calling mismatches exceed 0.5% of requests in a wave
Runbook and customer migration guide published to Confluence and linked in Console rollout UI
E2E tests cover: streaming chunk boundaries, tool-call argument reshaping, and structured-output JSON schema evolutions
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal shadow runs and replayer validation (2 weeks). Phase 1: invite-only canary for low-risk customers with opt-in behavior flags (2 weeks). Phase 2: progressive percentage waves controlled by orchestrator with telemetry gates; rollback on quality or error thresholds. Phase 3: full deprecation announcement + 30-day grace, then automated enforcement if opt-out rate < 5%. Each phase has checklist items produced by Sherpa and a staged communication template for Customer Success.
test_plan: Assemble replay corpus from last 90 days of streaming sessions (anonymized) and curated edge-case prompts
Create golden output set using stabilized runtime-1.22 baseline for structured-output schemas
Build a CI job that runs replayer against both legacy and new behavior flags, producing per-field semantic diffs and token-level divergence metrics
Instrumentation for tool-calls: track function signature mismatches, missing/extra args, and exception deltas
Fuzz harness for streaming boundary conditions (partial frames, early disconnects, tool-call mid-stream invocations)
SDK interop matrix tests (Node/Python/Go) exercising flag-driven behavior and fallback helpers
